<!-- pr-reviewer: c8f2752143a35852baa1785297e7f19f8c99cd20 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The setup transform agrees with `OpFrame::pose_in_setup`. The operation supplies its setup for the Extend button and edge selection. Edge selection still uses an undoable command.

Local results, after a trial merge with upstream/main `4e0b9abefcb225595d47d9c69a2482d6359b190f`:

- Build: `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` passed.
- Clippy: `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.
- App tests: `area_chains` 4 passed; `area_picks` 6 passed; `setup_align_2d_area` 5 passed.
- UI tests: `boundary` 3 passed; `boundary_picks` 7 passed; `edge_loop_pick` 4 passed.
- UI library: 964 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored. The graphics test could not find an adapter on this machine. The failure is an environment limit:

```text
egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds
egui headless run failed: no graphics adapter: software adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found; noop support not compiled in, vulkan support not compiled in, metal found no adapters, dx12 support not compiled in, gl support not compiled in, webgpu support not compiled in; hardware adapter: No suitable graphics adapter found; noop support not compiled in, vulkan support not compiled in, metal found no adapters, dx12 support not compiled in, gl support not compiled in, webgpu support not compiled in
```

Safety checks:

- Mutation 1: replaced `setup_align::pose_in` with `model::transform_of`. The setup-frame test failed at 90 degrees about X. The test passed after restoration.
- Mutation 2: changed the Extend button to call `extend_to_loop`. The operation-setup test failed. The test passed after restoration.
- No G-code, CL, or test golden files changed. There are no moved goldens to check.
- All temporary mutations were removed. No code or evidence was committed or pushed.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/boundary_draft.rs:314` and `crates/ui/src/edge_pick.rs:92`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the selected loop for an aligned setup. Tests do not replace this required visual evidence. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link the images from the body.

Note: `boundary_draft::take_pick` still uses the active setup for boundary Shift-click. The body states this limit. The changed button and edge-selection paths pass their tests.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: none. The latest review requests before/after screenshots of the selected loop in an aligned setup. That finding remains open.

This session cannot capture a display: `screencapture` reports `could not create image from display`. An existing `gpu_render` test executable was also probed with `CAMCRAFT_REQUIRE_GPU=1`. `box_stock_paints_steel_over_background` failed because both software and hardware adapter requests failed; Metal found no adapters. This probe establishes the host limitation, not a new test result for this PR head.

No source changes, new pins, mutations, images, or commits were made. The requested quick gate and app/UI clippy were started, then cancelled after confirming the screenshot blocker. Neither is reported green for this attempt.

Head remains c8f2752143a35852baa1785297e7f19f8c99cd20. The PR remains draft and its labels are unchanged. Please re-review after the required screenshots can be captured in a graphics-enabled session and linked from the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.

Addressed: the latest review’s missing before/after screenshots for aligned-setup loop selection. All four actual shell/GPU captures are now linked in the PR body. They are stored only on the fork’s images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at commit 1874a187aa3c58f81624f82571aa43aa317023e1.

- Extend to loop: the before image shows the vertical model-frame loop. The after image shows the horizontal loop in Setup2, aligned 90° about X. Pin: `extend_to_loop_button_uses_the_operations_aligned_setup`.
- Shift-click edge selection: the same before/after comparison shows the corrected horizontal loop. Pin: `shift_click_on_an_aligned_setup_closes_around_the_setup_horizontal_face`.

Both pins failed when `setup_align::pose_in` was temporarily replaced with the old `model::transform_of` lookup. Both passed after restoration. The temporary capture harness and mutation were removed. No source changes or evidence files were committed to the PR branch.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 2 steps, 0 failed. App/UI clippy passed across all targets with `-D warnings`.

PR head remains c8f2752143a35852baa1785297e7f19f8c99cd20. A plain push confirmed it is up to date. The PR remains draft and labels are unchanged. Please re-review the visual evidence in the updated PR body.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c8f2752143a35852baa1785297e7f19f8c99cd20 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This review follows the author's later comment with new visual evidence. The PR head did not change.

The earlier screenshot finding is satisfied. I withdraw the earlier request for changes. I inspected all four images linked from the PR body. Both comparisons show the selected loop move from the vertical model face to the horizontal face in aligned Setup2. The images are linked from the fork's screenshot commit. The PR changes no image files.

The pose lookup agrees with the generator's setup frame. The Extend button and edge selection supply the operation's setup. Edge selection still uses an undoable command. The tests cover an operation in Setup2 while Setup1 is active.

Local results, after a clean trial merge with upstream/main `3f41b8da6b65b8154132878e459d4430e3fb2063`:

- Build: `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` passed.
- Clippy: `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed with no warnings.
- App suites: `area_chains` 4 passed; `area_picks` 6 passed; `setup_align_2d_area` 5 passed.
- UI suites: `boundary` 3 passed; `boundary_picks` 7 passed; `edge_loop_pick` 4 passed.
- UI library: 1,000 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored. All UI checks ran from `crates/ui`.

The first setup-alignment run had four failures. The first UI library run had 52 failures. The test executables could not find runtime assets in their output directories. One diagnostic was:

```text
built-in post Fanuc: no posts folder found - the program needs its assets/posts directory beside the executable
```

I added links to this worktree's assets beside those test executables, under `target/` only. Both suites then passed as listed above. No source change was needed. The quick-gate dry run included old main changes, so I selected the affected suites directly. No GitHub runner was used.

Safety checks:

- Mutation 1 replaced `setup_align::pose_in` with `model::transform_of`. `extend_to_loop_reads_face_normals_in_the_setup_frame` failed at 90 degrees about X. It passed after restoration.
- Mutation 2 changed the Extend button to call `extend_to_loop`. `extend_to_loop_button_uses_the_operations_aligned_setup` failed on the selected loop. It passed after restoration.
- No G-code, CL, or golden files changed. There are no moved goldens to check.
- Both mutations were removed. The working files match the trial merge. No code or evidence was committed or pushed.

Requested before merge: none.

The PR body records that boundary Shift-click in `boundary_draft::take_pick` still uses the active setup. This PR changes the Extend button and edge-selection paths.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
